location.note: Place as reported by Serin (石门子村的霍比特徒步线). Travel and local sources place this trail at 华蓥市高兴镇石门子村 (also called 霍比特森林 / 华蓥山霍比特环线). Official 广安市行政区划 places 高兴镇 under 华蓥市 (https://www.guang-an.gov.cn/gasrmzfw/xzqy/pc/content/content_1718584923215175680.html). 区划地名网 notes 石门子村 was merged into 枧子沟村 in 2004, but the locality is still commonly called 石门子村. No exact hearing point or trailhead coordinates were obtained from a verified POI, so GPS was not recorded; this is the trail/village area, not a precise hearing location.

records.habitat: 停在屋脊瓦上；背后为山林，村落屋顶（约 463 米）
records.notes: White forehead and face, a sharply defined black throat/breast bib, black-and-white wings, and typical slim wagtail jizz on a tiled rooftop. In this region the white-faced, black-bibbed pattern usually belongs to the common form leucopsis (Amur/white-faced wagtail), but the bird was distant and partly hidden by tiles, so the subspecies is not certain. ID from photo.

records.habitat: 华蓥山中海拔落叶乔木冠层（约 804 米）
records.notes: ID from two distant, backlit photos plus observer notes (tit/leaf-warbler size, black eye-stripe, gray and green). Visible: long pale supercilium, dark eye-stripe, gray-olive (not bright yellow-green) upperparts, at least one pale wing bar, no obvious bright yellow coronal stripe or yellow rump. Pallas’s Leaf Warbler (Phylloscopus proregulus / 黄腰柳莺) not fully excluded because rump and crown stripe are poorly visible.
